test: Firebase submission upload behavior: writes the serialized submission to its owned metadata object as JSON
evidence: Static source/type comparison: the test casts `{ id: "sub-7", photos: [...] }` through `unknown` to SubmissionApiPayload. The actual interface (src/types/Api.ts) and buildSubmissionPayload caller use `{ submission, cats, photo_paths, photo_locations? }`; this fixture can never be emitted by the production caller. Since uploadSubmissionMetadata only JSON.stringify()s its argument, the path/MIME/serialization assertions are valid at that narrow boundary, but this case cannot catch a caller/wire-shape regression and its name implies more representative payload coverage than it provides. Not executed for this audit.
remaining_risk: A separate payload-builder test may cover the wire shape; this finding concerns this Firebase boundary test specifically.
flaw_details: Uses a payload object with fields absent from SubmissionApiPayload and omits all required fields via an unsafe cast.
